annotations.text:
Main direction: warm editorial — Instrument Serif + IBM Plex Sans/Mono, paper ground, ink, one oxide accent (tweakable).

Grey [bracketed] text marks facts I did not have: company names, dates, metrics, projects 2–3, case studies 2–3, roles 2–3, personal projects. The AI Agent Platform story is drafted from the brief; results are placeholders.

B and C are low-fi alternates for the hero only — pick one or keep Main.

Dark theme — same warm family, inverted: ground #161410, cream ink #ede8dc, oxide accent lifted to #d9764f so it passes contrast on dark; button text goes dark on the accent.

The ink blocks (principles, case result, mobile emphasis row) become raised warm-charcoal panels (#211e18) instead of cream slabs — less glare at night. Tell me if you'd rather keep them as inverted cream blocks.

On the site the theme follows the system setting (prefers-color-scheme), no JS and no toggle.
